function: Joint design of the BS transmit beamformer and the STAR-RIS transmission and reflection coefficients (phases, amplitudes) to maximize the secrecy rate (p. 1, 4).
system: Downlink MISO, BS with M=4 antennas, single-antenna user and eavesdropper, energy-splitting STAR-RIS with N=10 elements and coupled phases; no carrier frequency given, 1 MHz bandwidth (p. 3, 9).
method: SAC and L3APER-SAC deep reinforcement learning, fully connected networks (two hidden layers, 256 units), trained online by interacting with the simulated environment (p. 5, 8, 10).
data_channel: Custom simulator: BS-to-STAR-RIS link Rician (Kr = 5 dB), other links Rayleigh NLoS, 3D layout; no dataset, agent learns online from simulated interaction (p. 3, 9).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated in one simulated environment; sweeps over N, M, Pmax (N and M set network sizes); no unseen scenario tested (p. 4, 10, 11).
baselines: Classical: block coordinate descent with WMMSE and penalty dual decomposition; learned: DDPG, TD3; also own variants SAC and SAC-PSE (phase shift error) (p. 10).
metrics: Average secrecy rate (bps/Hz), average reward, policy loss, convergence curves with confidence intervals over 10 seeds, CDF of secrecy rate (p. 10, 11, 12).
complexity: L3APER-SAC worst-case runtime O(|G|), O(log|G|) priority updates, |G| = number of sampled transitions; no FLOPs, parameter count, or measured runtime (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 3: "We assume that the channel between BS and STAR-RIS is Ricean fading"; the other links are Rayleigh. Custom simulator, and no 3GPP model, public ray-tracing dataset, or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 4: "the dimensionality of the state space is Ds = 4M + 4N + 2MN"; sizes depend on M and N, p. 11 only sweeps N, M and Pmax, and no model trained in one condition is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 11: "when compared to TD3, DDPG, and traditional optimization schemes, our proposed algorithms consistently demonstrate superior performance"; p. 10 defines the traditional scheme as block coordinate descent; Fig. 9 plots secrecy rate for all of them.
q4_support: p. 9: "the overall time complexity of L3APER-SAC is dominated by O(|G|)"; an order of complexity for the replay-sampling cost of L3APER-SAC, with no FLOPs, parameter count, or measured runtime.
q5_support: p. 9: "the simulation parameters for the wireless network are presented in Table I, which are similar to those in work [9]"; custom simulator, no code or data link, and no public channel dataset.
notes: Area 3 although the objective is secrecy rate: the DRL agent outputs the BS beamformer and STAR-RIS coefficients (p. 4). q4 rests only on the O(|G|) replay order (p. 9), which the reviewer should confirm. Tables I and II were read from page images (p. 9, 10). The path-loss formulas on p. 3 are not attributed to 3GPP.
